hints.label: nudge
hints.text: The client did nothing wrong: it timed out and retried, which is normal. Ask what the server does when it sees the same request twice.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Read the request headers the client sends and check what the server does with them. Compare the two ledger rows and the timing of the timeout against the commit.

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: The server never honours the Idempotency-Key. Store it with a hash of the request under a unique (customer, key) constraint, claim it atomically before charging, replay the stored response on a repeat, and return 409 when the same key arrives with a different body.
